label: Possibly, the time before every populated moment has a first moment (BEGINS_1)
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise B1 in sense BEGINS_1, attribution deferred: some history accessible from the selected world has a moment at which a contingent concrete individual is present, and in that history the time before every moment at which a contingent concrete individual is present has a first moment (some moment at or before it has no earlier moment). It constrains time, not when contingent reality began: integer time empty before 0 and populated from 0 on fails it, and non-negative real time empty at 0 and populated after it satisfies it with no first populated moment. The first moment need not be populated; nothing is said about what is present at it or about a cause. 'Concrete' is the supplied Concrete parameter.
